verdict_text: B — Clean, compact, LINEAR & projectable action latent IS recoverable (action-predictive with large gain over e, near-zero env leakage, action-specific under deconfounding & recombination), BUT it is NOT a causal bottleneck of the frozen head: the tier-1 intervention FAILS (action is redundantly distributed across h).
